# POWER SHIFT

> Software studio in Cairo building high-performance websites, e-commerce platforms, SaaS products, and custom operations systems for companies in Egypt and the GCC.

POWER SHIFT designs, builds, and supports bilingual Arabic/English products. Work is scoped in a 20-minute call, then delivered with a named owner through launch and maintenance.

## Site

- [Home](https://www.powershift.space/): Studio overview, 5-star client reviews, selected work, services, process, and FAQ

- [Work](https://www.powershift.space/work): Live product case studies
- [Work (Arabic)](https://www.powershift.space/ar/work): Arabic portfolio overview for published website, commerce, and software projects
- [Services](https://www.powershift.space/services): Websites, e-commerce, SaaS, and operations systems
- [Services (Arabic)](https://www.powershift.space/ar/services): Arabic overview of website, e-commerce, SaaS, and operations-system services

## Reviews

Client reviews published on the site are all 5 stars (15 reviews). The words are published as the clients sent them, in Arabic or English.

Themes clients mention: clarifying the brief, communication during the build, a site that is not a generic template, a link they can send instead of explaining the business each time, remote work that stayed clear, and a control panel so they do not need a developer for every change.

Reviewers: مروان الشاذلي, ياسين العتيبي, Nour El Din, بسنت عادل, راشد المنهالي, Mina Fawzy, حازم الديب, لولوة الهاجري, Salma Nabil, محمود صبري, مشعل الدوسري, Karim Samir, رنا فؤاد, عبدالرحمن الشمري, Maya Hassan.

To leave a review, clients message Power Shift on WhatsApp.
